_meta.description: Relay dev logs. priority 200 beats Elasticsearch's built-in logs-*-* template (100) so index.lifecycle.name points at a policy that actually deletes; the built-in logs policy rolls over but never deletes, which on a laptop means unbounded growth. number_of_replicas must be 0: on a single node any replica leaves the cluster permanently yellow, which the compose healthcheck's wait_for_status=yellow would then mask.
